entities.summary: Darnell Henry Savage Jr. is an American professional football safety for the Pittsburgh Steelers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Maryland Terrapins and was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the first round of the 2019 NFL draft. Savage has also played for the Jacksonville Jaguars and Washington Commanders.
